card.name: Adverbs of degree after verbs
card.fires_on: Adverbs such as long, sooner, deeper, far, farther or properly that follow a verb and are often followed by 'enough', 'or', or 'than'. They appear in general web text and in product instructions.

modes.label: Adverb before enough
modes.description: Long, far or farther after a verb, in phrases like 'go far enough' or 'around long enough'.

modes.label: Rinse sooner / use less
modes.description: Comparative adverb ending a verb phrase in skin product directions.
modes.example: it may be controlled by rinsing off Sodium Sulfacetamide 9% - Sulfur 4% Wash<< sooner>> or using less often.

modes.label: Manner adverb after verb
modes.description: Adverb of manner right after a verb phrase, such as properly or tightly.
modes.example: Failure to insert NEXPLANON<< properly>> may go unnoticed unless it is palpated
